posts.name: Belle Sorciere
posts.cooked:
What are some combinations of villain and environment people have had fun with?

I don't really have a lot of favorites, and I mostly remember the environments that messed me up - like Realm of Discord and La Capitan, and not having any environment destruction. Things were great until La Capitan got some targets out and the environment played Claustrophobic Delusion. It went through like four distortions in a row but once it got that one, other distortions stopped coming out.

Thematically, I enjoyed Grand Warlord Voss in Megalopolis, mainly because it reminded me of the Battle of New York. 

So really, I am asking thematically (although there are threads about that already) and especially mechanically.

Oddly, the Earth Spirit can do great in The Block.  And probably the Enclave of Endings.

posts.name: Ameena
posts.cooked:
Heh, try Omni-10 (and others) versus Omnitron in Omnitron IV. And umm...don't expect it to go amazingly well for your heroes ;).

Ra in Insula Primalis is fun once the volcano comes out, as long as you have Flesh of the Sun God >:).

Akash'Bhuta in the Freedom Tower is relatively easy as there are no environment targets at all. Contrast with somewhere like the Final Wasteland where nearly every card is a target.

Rook City in general is a nasty, nasty place nd tends to bump up the difficulty level no matter who you're fighting. Megalopolis can be a different kind of difficult because of all the "You can't do X" cards it has that can turn what looked like a relatively straightforward win into a horrible wipe (yes, I've been there, aaaages ago...we were against Dawn, I believe) :P.

posts.name: eggroll20xd6
posts.cooked: Not sure if I played it correctly, but I believe I did.  I had Dark Watch Nightmist, Infinite Scholar, and the Hunted Naturalist against Bugbear, Biomancer, and Greezer in the Court of Blood environment.  Scholar got taken out early as was Biomancer, Greezer went down just before the Naturalist and Nightmist was hanging by a thread.  I forget the name of the card, but Nightmist turned into her mist form and Bugbear only could try and hit her.  The vampires eventually took him down enough that Nightmist came out of her form and landed the finishing blow.  I never thought I would be grateful for the help of vampires.
